# Kromaloom

> Website design studio for small businesses in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom and the UAE. We redesign dated websites and build new ones: mobile-first, fast, with search basics built in. Every prospect gets a free concept of their new homepage within 24 hours, before paying anything.

## Services and founding prices
- Website redesign: CA$299 / US$249 / £199 / AED 899, live in 24 hours
- New website (up to 5 pages, copy included): CA$499 / US$399 / £299 / AED 1,499, live in 48 hours
- Online store (Shopify or WooCommerce, up to 20 products): CA$999 / US$799 / £599 / AED 2,899, live in 3 to 5 days
- Care plans after launch from CA$29 per month
- Second-language versions (Arabic, French) at +50% of the package

## Terms
- No upfront payment: built on a private preview link, paid after approval, then launched
- Client owns domain, hosting and all files
